input:
the reserve authorisation delay blocks everything until the approver returns.
The system halts all claim processing when a reserve change requires authorization, waiting for the approver to return.

I’m having trouble logging into the system — I think I need to reset my password.
The customer is unable to log into the system and requires a password reset.

I’m having trouble locating the updated reserves after finalising a claim
The user cannot find updated reserve figures after completing a claim.

claims held up because when a reserve change exceeds authority, it sits in one approver’s queue with no delegate, and that creates a backlog on the approval waiting list
Reserve changes exceeding authority get stuck in a single approver's queue without delegation options, causing payment delays and backlogs.

No delegate at all — and it’s causing delays on reserve updates that need sign-off before we can process payments.
The lack of a delegate option for approvers is causing delays in processing payments because reserve updates cannot be signed off.

We’re still wrestling with how claim progress messages go out — it’s all manual right now and we’re behind on updates.
The process for sending claim progress messages is currently manual, causing delays in updates.

Exactly. That’s the problem — no warning, no link option, just two claims.
The platform displays duplicate claims without providing any warning or an option to link them together.

the system doesn’t warn us. It creates duplicate claims and messes up our reserves and reporting... the system doesn’t show any warning at intake, which leads to duplicate records and inaccurate reserves.
The system fails to detect or warn about duplicate claims when the same loss is reported through multiple channels, leading to inaccurate reserves and reporting.

when a reserve change goes beyond what a handler can approve, it just sits there.
Reserve changes that exceed a handler's approval limit remain stuck in the system without being routed for further action.

we’re getting locked out of Keelwater every time we try to log in — it keeps saying the system is down, but I’m pretty sure it’s not actually your side.
Users are unable to log in because the system incorrectly reports that it is down.

we’re having trouble pulling the latest reserves report for a high-value marine claim, and it’s holding up our payment cycle.
The user is unable to retrieve the latest reserves report for a specific claim, which is delaying their payment process.

the same claim twice appears because the system doesn’t alert staff when a matching incident already exists in intake — we’ve had to manually link them after the fact, which delays payments and reporting.
The system fails to alert staff when a duplicate claim is entered, forcing manual linking which delays payments and reporting.

every time we need to update a policyholder or adjust reserves, we have to interrupt our workflow to phone suppliers because repair updates missing means no visibility.
The platform lacks visibility into repair updates, forcing users to leave the workflow and call suppliers to update policyholders or adjust reserves.

Claims: click "Next"
Claims: click "Overview", dead x1
The 'Overview' button in the claims interface is unresponsive or broken.

I need to reset my password because I can’t access the claims dashboard to upload documents.
The user cannot access the claims dashboard to upload documents due to a password issue.

we’re getting the same claim twice when a policyholder reports via phone and then the portal — no alert pops up at intake.
The system fails to alert users when a claim is submitted twice via different channels (phone and portal).

Our motor team wants more automatic claim allocation based on postcode and workload, but commercial prefers manual control for complex cases — we need per-team configuration.
The platform lacks the ability to configure claim allocation rules differently for different teams.

I need to flag something about uploading files together. We handle hundreds daily and need bulk uploads.
The customer needs a bulk file upload feature to handle high daily document volumes efficiently.

a policyholder reported the same incident both over the phone and through the web portal, and it created two separate claims without any alert.
The system fails to detect and merge duplicate claims submitted through different channels, creating separate records without warning.

And when reserves go over limit? The approval waiting list just sits there if the approver’s out.
The approval workflow stalls when an approver is unavailable, causing a backlog for claims exceeding reserve limits.

I can’t access the documents section — it’s saying my credentials are expired.
The user is unable to access the documents section because their credentials are reported as expired.

Right now, it’s one by one, which slows us down.
The platform does not support bulk file uploads when creating new claims, forcing users to upload documents individually.

We’re constantly phoning suppliers because there’s no live repair status, which is a daily blocker for us — garage progress visibility is critical to our workflow.
The platform lacks live repair status updates from suppliers, forcing users to manually call them for progress visibility.

repair updates missing — we’re on the phone daily with garages because there’s no live status.
The platform lacks live repair status updates, forcing customers to call garages daily for information.

We’re running claims reports late into the evening and the bright interface is straining our eyes — any chance we can get dark mode enabled?
The bright interface causes eye strain during late-night work sessions, and the user requests a dark mode option.

Suppliers: click "Save", rage x3
The save action for suppliers is unreliable or frustrating, causing repeated failures.

reserve updates beyond handler limits are stuck waiting for sign-off with no backup approver, causing a reserve authorisation delay that halts payments and reporting.
Reserve updates exceeding handler limits get stuck in approval queues because there is no backup approver configured, which delays payments and reporting.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal — I’ve forgotten it and can’t log in to check my reserves or documents.
The user cannot access the claims portal to view reserves or documents because they have forgotten their password and need a reset.

We just need some stability so we can focus on policyholders, not relearning the software.
The software is unstable due to frequent changes, forcing users to constantly relearn it instead of focusing on their core tasks.

We’ve had three people report the same customer login outage today, and it’s holding up claims processing
Customers are experiencing login outages that prevent them from accessing the platform, which delays claims processing.

uploaded documents sometimes end up misfiled — garage estimates get tagged as correspondence, and handlers have to move them manually, which risks missing critical evidence.
Uploaded documents are automatically misclassified into the wrong file types, requiring manual correction by handlers which creates a risk of missing critical evidence.

I’m not seeing the upload button on the claims tab.
The user cannot locate the document upload button on the claims tab.

I’m trying to reconcile the latest payment batch with our suppliers’ invoices but can’t locate the matching documents in the system.
The user is unable to find the specific supplier invoices needed to reconcile a payment batch within the system.

Also, can we get a summary of recent tasks and letters tied to our account?
The customer wants a feature to view a summary of recent tasks and letters associated with their account.

we’re still stuck calling garages manually because the system doesn’t show live repair updates — it’s a daily headache. The repair updates missing is a daily blocker — we have to call every garage to get status
The platform lacks live repair status updates, forcing users to manually call garages for information.

Tasks: click "Details"
Tasks: click "Save", rage x3
The user is frustrated by the repetitive and cumbersome process of saving task details.

our finance team needs clearer reporting on reserves versus actual payments — it’s causing delays in supplier reconciliation.
The current reporting on reserves versus actual payments is not clear enough, leading to delays in supplier reconciliation.

We’re getting the same claim twice when a policyholder reports via phone and then the portal — no alert pops up at intake, and it’s causing duplicate records.
The system fails to detect or alert users about duplicate claims when a policyholder submits the same claim through both phone and portal channels.

I’m trying to get a batch of policyholder documents into a single claim — is there a way to do that without uploading each one separately?
The user wants to upload multiple documents to a single claim at once but currently has to do it one by one.

can we at least manually merge them without losing any documents or supplier notes?
The customer needs a way to manually merge duplicate claims without losing associated documents or notes.

garage estimates keep landing in Correspondence, and our handlers have to manually move them, which risks missing critical evidence.
Garage estimates are incorrectly categorized as Correspondence, forcing manual reclassification and risking missed evidence.

We’ve got handlers spending hours on the phone instead of processing claims or managing reserves.
The platform lacks automated status updates from garages, forcing handlers to spend excessive time on manual phone calls instead of processing claims.

Documents: click "Document type", rage x5
The user is frustrated and clicking the 'Document type' button repeatedly, likely because it is not responding or functioning correctly.

the system won’t accept the supplier’s invoice format
The system rejects supplier invoices in a specific format during document upload.

Our motor team wants claims routed automatically based on postcode and workload, but our specialty handlers need manual control for complex cases
The current routing system cannot simultaneously support automatic assignment for motor claims and manual control for specialty handlers.

if you can flag any pending letters or documents that might be blocked too, that’d help us plan ahead.
The customer wants the platform to automatically identify and flag pending letters or documents that are currently blocked.

We’re seeing a duplicate loss report scenario where the same incident comes in via phone and portal, creating two claims without any intake warning — we’ve even spotted disabled UI buttons that should allow linking but don’t work.
The system creates duplicate claims when the same incident is reported via multiple channels without warning, and the UI buttons intended to link these duplicates are non-functional.

Our reporting team’s been waiting on those reserves to update, and it’s holding up the month-end close.
Reserves data is not updating in the reporting module, causing delays in the month-end close process.

I’m trying to set up some saved filters on the claims list to help my team track high-priority cases, but I can’t seem to lock them in properly.
The user is unable to successfully save filters on the claims list.

it’s not accepting my current one even though I’m certain it’s correct.
The claims portal is rejecting the user's correct password, preventing them from logging in.

the system’s not showing the supplier invoices correctly.
The system is failing to display supplier invoices correctly during the reconciliation of claims payments against reserves.

The interface changes last month moved key controls without warning — we had to retrain staff because of those unexpected interface changes.
Unexpected interface changes moved key controls, forcing staff to undergo retraining.

The payments show as pending but reserves aren’t updating.
Reserves are not updating for commercial property claims even though payments are marked as pending.

it’s definitely a customer network failure, not Keelwater being down, though the error message makes it sound like a bug.
The error message for customer network failures is misleading because it implies a Keelwater system bug.

We’ve got three claims stuck waiting on garage replies again today.
Claims are stalled because the platform does not provide live updates on garage repair status.

just the approval waiting list is the big blocker
The approval waiting list is currently the main obstacle for the user.

I’m trying to get a batch of claim docs into the system for Kilnsey Household but it’s taking ages one by one. Any way to speed this up?
The current process for uploading claim documents is too slow because it requires handling them one by one instead of in batches.

our policyholders keep asking why they don’t get automatic updates when their claim moves to the next stage. We’ve had multiple policyholders ask why they aren’t getting automatic alerts when their claim status changes
Policyholders are not receiving automatic notifications when their claim status changes to a new stage.

We’re also struggling with task assignments and letter generation—sometimes policyholders don’t get timely updates.
The platform's task assignment and letter generation features are causing delays in policyholder updates.

We’re still having to call garages ourselves every day because the repair updates missing from the system — it’s becoming a real time-sink for our handlers.
The system fails to display repair updates, forcing handlers to manually call garages daily.

we need to schedule regular reviews for reserves and supplier payments—any way to automate that in Keelwater?
The customer wants to automate the scheduling of regular reviews for reserves and supplier payments within Keelwater.

especially if we can see how reserves and payments sync with supplier updates in real time
The customer needs real-time visibility into how reserves and payments align with supplier updates.

We’re having trouble pulling the latest reserves report for our policyholders — it’s showing outdated figures even after we refreshed the tasks list.
The reserves report displays outdated figures despite refreshing the tasks list.

Your interface changes lately — controls moving without warning — it’s forcing us to retrain staff constantly, and unannounced screen changes are disrupting our operations.
The user interface changes frequently and without warning, causing operational disruption and requiring constant staff retraining.
